items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: He taught me the waltz, and he taught me the scales... I took about three lessons from him.

ctx.x: I had to have a book to start with. He taught me the waltz, and he taught me the scales, and things like that, and the simple tunes to play. In fact, he taught me more than Picou ever taught me. Now, that's the only teacher I ever had in Baton Rouge, was Manuel Roque, and Isadore Fritz(?) would come around and give me a few lessons for free.
Let me just finish up with Manuel Roque, and then we'll get to Isadore Fritz. Did Manuel Roque ever tell you any clarinet player that you should go listen to, or the ones that he liked?
